coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay South Block 15A
record.summary: Block 15A is part of the undeveloped Block 15 at UCSF's Mission Bay North Campus, which UCSF's Long Range Development Plan designates for housing (the 2014 plan's environmental review analysed housing and a relocated child care facility there). UCSF's June 2025 presentation lists it among the 'undeveloped parcels remaining' and says UCSF has 'no building plans at Mission Bay right now'; no project, developer or date is stated in any source found.

notes.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced; only the internal A/B split line is approximate (a bisection, since no real street divides this block into A and B).
notes.digitized_from: Real block boundary built from DataSF's official street centerlines; the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.

open_questions: No source found states when Block 15 housing will be built, who will build it, how many units, or whether it is student, faculty or other housing: UCSF's June 2025 deck only lists the use and says it has no building plans at Mission Bay right now.

The 2014 Long Range Development Plan document itself (the UCSF Real Estate and Campus Planning pages) could not be read when this was checked (access blocked); the plan's use for Block 15 is taken from UCSF's June 2025 deck and from the 2017 addenda's recital of the 2014 environmental report.
The A/B split: only OCII's land use map separates 15A from 15B; no source read says how the planned housing divides between them.
OCII's December 2019 Mission Bay Land Use Map labels this parcel; its colour legend has a 'UCSF' category (the map's colour fill is graphic, not text, so the use shown there was not read as text).
Current ground conditions (parked cars noted in this record's notes) come from aerial imagery, not a document, and are not asserted here.
Timing for Block 15: the only date in UCSF's June 12, 2025 Mission Bay CAC presentation, 'After 2035', is attached to South Campus Phase 2 (hospital, parking), not to this block.

No source published since October 2025 was found for this block's status; the summary rests on UCSF's June 2025 presentation. UCSF's own housing and planning pages could not be read to check for a newer update.

No source dated after June 12, 2025 was found that describes plans for this block: a search for a newer UCSF or OCII Mission Bay presentation on October 13, 2026 turned up none. The most recent source is UCSF's June 12, 2025 presentation.
